# IT Security and Operations Protocol

This protocol outlines critical tasks for IT security and operations:

*   Investigate encryption standards for Strategy 2026.
*   Conduct quarterly reviews of database migration processes.
*   Update firewall settings as part of Strategy 2026 implementation.
*   Review API latency on a quarterly basis.
*   Urgently investigate current encryption standards.
